model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and a coverage metric for several datasets. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.4 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. A blue solid line with circular markers represents the "Llama-3B" dataset, starting at a value of approximately 0.38 at x = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.79 at x = 2⁸. A green dashed line with triangular markers represents the "Llama-3B + FT" dataset, starting at approximately 0.36 at x = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.78 at x = 2⁸. A light blue solid line with circular markers represents the "Llama-1B" dataset, starting at approximately 0.35 at x = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.76 at x = 2⁸. A light green dashed line with triangular markers represents the "Llama-1B + FT" dataset, starting at approximately 0.34 at x = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.75 at x = 2⁸.
